assumptions.arm effect (0 to 10 points): assumption: the quantity the test is meant to detect
assumptions.heterogeneity kappa (1, 4): assumption: no pilot evidence; low kappa = instances mostly always solved or never solved, so the arms' outcomes are strongly correlated
assumptions.overall resolved rate (10, 20, 30%): assumption: no resolved rate has been measured
assumptions.same reply in repeated runs (0.635): measured on the 100-instance pilot (Flash-Lite, BM25 and RRF), dev instances, a different model may differ
assumptions.same usability (97.5%): measured in the pilot; not modelled separately: an unusable reply is an unresolved outcome and is inside the resolve probability
